name: sell-buy
description: E-commerce marketplace built as event-driven microservices (Node.js + TypeScript + MongoDB + Kafka)

scripts.build: npm run build:common && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:common && concurrently -n gateway,auth,catalog,order,notify,web -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue,white "npm:dev:gateway" "npm:dev:auth" "npm:dev:catalog" "npm:dev:order" "npm:dev:notification" "npm:dev:web"
